# UpEast Energies

> UpEast Energies Solutions Limited is a renewable energy and infrastructure company delivering reliable, innovative and sustainable solar power, battery storage, inverters and clean energy solutions for homes, businesses, institutions, and governments across Africa. Tagline: "Powering the Future of Energy in Africa." Head office in Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria; operations/warehouse hub in Aba, Abia State, Nigeria.

## What we do
UpEast Energies designs, supplies, installs and supports renewable energy systems. We help customers cut reliance on the grid and diesel with solar and battery storage that is dependable and built for the African environment.

## Products
- Hybrid inverters — 1KVA, 3KVA, 5KVA, 10KVA, 20KVA (commercial), 50KVA and 100KVA (industrial)
- Battery & energy storage systems — from 15kWh residential lithium to 100kWh, 250kWh, 500kWh, 1MWh, 2MWh, 5MWh and 10MWh commercial/industrial storage
- Solar panels — residential, commercial/government, glass and transparent-glass panels
- Solar street lights — standard, smart, and rural-community solutions
- Solar kits and solar accessories
- Tailored solutions for government (MDAs), churches & mosques, and residential customers

## Services
- Consultancy / energy advisory
- Installation (residential, commercial, institutional)
- PAYG (Pay-As-You-Go) financing plans
- Concierge services
- 24/7 customer support
- After-sales support and maintenance

## Who we serve
Homes and residential customers; businesses large and small (SMEs, corporates, factories, real estate developers); institutions (churches, mosques, schools, NGOs); and government ministries, departments and agencies.
